questions.question_en: According to the case scenario of the 58-year-old male with acute anterior STEMI and BP 88/54 mmHg, which of the following routine anti-anginal drugs is CONTRAINDICATED in the immediate nursing management?
questions.question_mr: तीव्र अँटीरियर STEMI आणि ८८/५४ mmHg रक्तदाब असलेल्या ५८ वर्षीय पुरुषाच्या केस संदर्भानुसार, खालीलपैकी कोणते अँटी-अँजायनल औषध तात्काळ नर्सिंग व्यवस्थापनात वर्ज्य (कॉन्ट्राइंडिकेटेड) आहे?
questions.explanation_en: Sublingual Nitroglycerin is a potent vasodilator and is contraindicated when Systolic Blood Pressure is below 90 mmHg (hypotension) or in suspected right ventricular infarction, as it causes severe profound circulatory collapse.
questions.explanation_mr: नायट्रोग्लिसरीन हे रक्तवाहिन्या रुंद करणारे औषध आहे. सिस्टोलिक रक्तदाब ९० mmHg पेक्षा कमी असताना ते दिल्यास तीव्र हायपोटेन्शन आणि सर्क्युलेटरी कोलॅप्स होऊ शकतो. त्यामुळे ते या रुग्णात वर्ज्य आहे.
questions.exam_name: NORCET

questions.question_en: The doctor orders Thrombolytic therapy with Streptokinase for this patient. Prior to starting the infusion, which nursing assessment is an ABSOLUTE contraindication for thrombolytic administration?
questions.question_mr: डॉक्टरांनी या रुग्णाला स्ट्रेप्टोकायनेजसह थ्रोम्बोलाइटिक थेरपी देण्याचे आदेश दिले. इन्फ्युजन सुरू करण्यापूर्वी, थ्रोम्बोलाइटिक औषध देण्यासाठी खालीलपैकी कोणती स्थिती परिपूर्ण प्रतिबंध (Absolute Contraindication) आहे?
questions.option_a_en: Active peptic ulcer treated 6 months ago
questions.option_b_en: Prior ischemic stroke 4 months ago or history of hemorrhagic stroke at any time
questions.option_b_mr: ४ महिन्यांपूर्वी झालेला इस्केमिक स्ट्रोक किंवा कधीही झालेला मेंदूतील रक्तस्राव (Hemorrhagic Stroke)
questions.explanation_en: Any prior intracranial hemorrhage, known cerebrovascular structural lesion, or ischemic stroke within 3-6 months is an absolute contraindication to thrombolysis due to the high risk of fatal cerebral bleeding.
questions.explanation_mr: कधीही झालेला मेंदूतील रक्तस्राव (Hemorrhagic Stroke) किंवा मागील काही महिन्यांतील स्ट्रोक थ्रोम्बोलाइटिक उपचारासाठी परिपूर्ण प्रतिबंध असतो, कारण यामुळे घातक मेंदू रक्तस्रावाचा मोठा धोका असतो.
questions.exam_name: NORCET

questions.question_en: During continuous ECG monitoring, the telemetry shows broad bizarre QRS complexes at 160 bpm with no P waves. The patient suddenly becomes unresponsive and pulseless. What is the immediate priority nursing action?
questions.question_mr: सतत ईसीजी मॉनिटरिंग दरम्यान, टेलीमेट्रीवर १६० bpm वेगाने रुंद विचित्र QRS कॉम्प्लेक्स दिसतात आणि P वेव्ह नसते. रुग्ण अचानक बेशुद्ध होतो आणि नाडी लागत नाही. तात्काळ प्राधान्य नर्सिंग कृती कोणती?
questions.option_b_en: Call for help (Code Blue) and immediately begin CPR and prepare for unsynchronized defibrillation
questions.option_b_mr: मदतीसाठी हाक मारा (कोड ब्लू) आणि त्वरित सीपीआर सुरू करा व डिफेब्रिलेटर तयार करा
questions.option_c_en: Check blood glucose level with glucometer
questions.explanation_en: Pulseless Ventricular Tachycardia (VT) is a shockable cardiac arrest rhythm. In accordance with ACLS guidelines, the immediate action is initiating high-quality chest compressions and immediate defibrillation as soon as available.
questions.explanation_mr: पल्सलेस व्हेंट्रिक्युलर टाचिकार्डिया (VT) ही कार्डियाक अरेस्टची स्थिती आहे. ACLS मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वांनुसार, त्वरित उच्च दर्जाचे छातीचे कॉम्प्रेशन (CPR) सुरू करणे आणि उपलब्ध होताच त्वरित डिफेब्रिलेशन करणे हे सर्वोच्च प्राधान्य आहे.
questions.exam_name: ESIC Nursing Officer

questions.question_en: For the 26-year-old primigravida with severe pre-eclampsia (BP 168/110 mmHg, 4+ reflexes, ankle clonus), which drug of choice is administered to prevent eclamptic seizures?
questions.question_mr: तीव्र प्री-एक्लॅम्पसिया (बीपी १६८/११० mmHg, ४+ रिफ्लेक्स, क्लोनस) असलेल्या २६ वर्षीय गरोदर मातेमध्ये आकडी (एक्लॅम्पटिक सीझर्स) रोखण्यासाठी कोणते प्रथम पसंतीचे औषध दिले जाते?
questions.option_c_en: Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO4) via Pritchard or Zuspan regimen
questions.option_c_mr: मॅग्नेशियम सल्फेट (MgSO4) प्रिचार्ड किंवा झुस्पन पद्धतीनुसार
questions.explanation_en: Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO4) is the anticonvulsant drug of choice for the prevention and treatment of eclamptic convulsions in severe pre-eclampsia and eclampsia (proven superior to diazepam and phenytoin by the Eclampsia Collaborative Trial).
questions.explanation_mr: तीव्र प्री-एक्लॅम्पसिया आणि एक्लॅम्पसियामध्ये आकडी रोखण्यासाठी आणि उपचारासाठी मॅग्नेशियम सल्फेट (MgSO4) हे जगभरात सिद्ध झालेले प्रथम पसंतीचे अँटीकन्व्हलसंट औषध आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS Nursing Officer

questions.question_en: A nurse administering Magnesium Sulfate must assess for toxicity before every maintenance dose. If the patient develops absent knee-jerk reflexes, RR 10/min, and oliguria, what is the specific ANTIDOTE to be kept bedside?
questions.question_mr: मॅग्नेशियम सल्फेट देणाऱ्या परिचारिकेने प्रत्येक डोसनंतर विषारीपणा (टॉक्सिसिटी) तपासणे आवश्यक आहे. रुग्णाचे गुडघ्याचे प्रतिक्षिप्त क्रिया (नी-जर्क) नष्ट झाल्यास आणि श्वसन दर १०/मिनिट झाल्यास, बेडजवळ कोणता विशिष्ट अँटीडोट (प्रतिविष) ठेवला पाहिजे?
questions.option_b_en: 10% Calcium Gluconate (10 mL IV over 10 minutes)
questions.explanation_en: 10% Calcium Gluconate is the direct antagonist and antidote for Magnesium Sulfate toxicity. The nurse must withhold MgSO4 and administer 10 ml of 10% Calcium Gluconate slowly IV over 10 minutes.
questions.explanation_mr: मॅग्नेशियम सल्फेट टॉक्सिसिटीसाठी १०% कॅल्शियम ग्लुकोनेट हे थेट प्रतिविष (अँटीडोट) आहे. श्वसन मंदावल्यास किंवा रिफ्लेक्स गहाळ झाल्यास हे औषध त्वरित दिले जाते.
questions.exam_name: NORCET

questions.question_en: While measuring blood pressure in an adult patient, if the blood pressure cuff size is TOO NARROW or loose, what will be the effect on the reading?
questions.question_mr: प्रौढ रुग्णामध्ये रक्तदाब मोजताना, जर बीपी कफ खूप अरुंद किंवा सैल असेल, तर रीडिंगवर काय परिणाम होईल?
questions.option_c_en: Accurate systolic, but elevated diastolic only
questions.option_c_mr: सिस्टोलिक बरोबर, परंतु फक्त डायस्टोलिक जास्त येईल
questions.option_d_en: No significant effect on automated machines
questions.option_d_mr: ऑटोमेटेड मशीनवर कोणताही परिणाम होणार नाही
questions.explanation_en: A blood pressure cuff that is too small, too narrow, or wrapped too loosely requires extra pressure to occlude the artery, resulting in a FALSELY HIGH blood pressure reading. Conversely, an oversized cuff yields a falsely low reading.
questions.explanation_mr: खूप अरुंद किंवा सैल कफ असल्यास धमनी दाबण्यासाठी जास्त हवेच्या दाबाची गरज भासते, ज्यामुळे रक्तदाब चुकीचा जास्त (फॉल्सली हाय) नोंदवला जातो.
questions.exam_name: NORCET

questions.question_en: Which surgical/nursing position is most suitable for a patient undergoing lumbar puncture, and what position should the patient maintain for 4 to 6 hours immediately after the procedure?
questions.question_mr: लंबर पंक्चर (LP) प्रक्रियेसाठी रुग्णाला कोणती स्थिती सर्वाधिक योग्य आहे आणि प्रक्रियेनंतर लगेच ४ ते ६ तास रुग्णाने कोणती स्थिती राखली पाहिजे?
questions.option_a_en: During: High Fowler position; After: Trendelenburg position
questions.option_b_en: During: C-shaped Lateral decubitus (fetal) position; After: Flat Supine / Prone without pillow
questions.option_b_mr: प्रक्रियेदरम्यान: C-आकाराची कुशीवर वळलेली (गर्भस्थ) स्थिती; प्रक्रियेनंतर: उशीशिवाय सपाट पाठीवर (फ्लॅट सुपाइन)
questions.option_c_en: During: Prone with sandbag; After: Semi-Fowler with elevation
questions.option_d_en: During: Lithotomy position; After: Reverse Trendelenburg
questions.explanation_en: During lumbar puncture, the patient is placed in the lateral recumbent "fetal" position with neck flexed to chest and knees drawn up, which widens the intervertebral spaces. After LP, remaining flat supine for 4-6 hours prevents post-dural puncture spinal headache.
questions.explanation_mr: लंबर पंक्चर दरम्यान मनक्यांमधील जागा रुंद करण्यासाठी सी-आकाराची गर्भस्थ स्थिती दिली जाते. प्रक्रियेनंतर सेरेब्रोस्पाइनल फ्लुइड (CSF) गळतीमुळे होणारी डोकेदुखी (Spinal Headache) टाळण्यासाठी रुग्णाला ४ ते ६ तास सपाट पाठीवर झोपवले जाते.
questions.exam_name: ESIC Nursing Officer

questions.question_en: According to the revised Biomedical Waste Management Rules (India), in which color-coded container should human anatomical waste, soiled dressings, cotton swabs, and expired cytotoxic drugs be disposed of?
questions.question_mr: भारतातील सुधारित बायोमेडिकल कचरा व्यवस्थापन नियमांनुसार मानवी अवयव कचरा, रक्त लागलेले मलमपट्टी/कापूस आणि कालबाह्य सायटोटॉक्सिक औषधे कोणत्या रंगाच्या डब्यात/पिशवीत टाकली जातात?
questions.option_c_en: Blue Cardboard Box or Puncture proof container
questions.explanation_en: Yellow bags are designated for human anatomical waste, animal waste, soiled cotton/gauze/bandages, microbiological waste, and expired/discarded medicines, which are destined for incineration or plasma pyrolysis.
questions.explanation_mr: पिवळ्या पिशव्या मानवी शारीरिक कचरा, दूषित कापूस/ड्रेसिंग साहित्य आणि कालबाह्य औषधांसाठी राखीव असतात. त्यांची विल्हेवाट इन्सिनरेशन (दहन) द्वारे लावली जाते.
questions.exam_name: Maharashtra DMER Staff Nurse

questions.question_en: Used disposable syringes without needles, IV tubing sets, Foley catheters, and urine bags should be disposed of in which color category container?
questions.question_mr: सुया नसलेले वापरलेले डिस्पोजेबल सिरींज, सलाईन (IV) नळ्या, कॅथेटर्स आणि युरिन बॅग्स कोणत्या रंगाच्या कचराकुंडीत टाकल्या जातात?
questions.option_b_en: Red non-chlorinated container for autoclaving and recycling
questions.explanation_en: Red containers are designated for recyclable contaminated plastic wastes such as IV tubings, catheters, syringes without needles, and vacutainers, which are sterilized by autoclaving/microwaving and then shredded.
questions.explanation_mr: लाल रंगाच्या पिशवीत पुनर्वापर करण्यायोग्य प्लास्टिक साहित्य जसे की IV सेट, कॅथेटर, सुई नसलेली सिरिंज टाकली जाते. यांचे ऑटोक्लेव्हिंग करून पुनर्वापर केला जातो.
questions.exam_name: NORCET

questions.question_en: A neonate is evaluated at 1 minute of life: Heart rate is 110 bpm, slow irregular cry with weak respiratory effort, some flexion of extremities, grimace on suctioning, and body is pink with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the calculated APGAR score?
questions.question_mr: जन्मानंतर १ मिनिटाने नवजात बालकाचे मूल्यांकन केले जाते: हृदय गती ११० bpm, कमकुवत रडणे/अनियमित श्वास, हात-पायांचे थोडे आकुंचन (flexion), सक्शन करताना चेहरा आकुंचन पावणे, आणि शरीर गुलाबी पण हात-पाय निळसर (acrocyanosis). APGAR स्कोर किती येईल?
questions.explanation_en: Breakdown: Heart rate >100 bpm = 2 points; Respiratory effort (slow/irregular) = 1 point; Muscle tone (some flexion) = 1 point; Reflex irritability (grimace) = 1 point; Color (acrocyanosis - pink body, blue hands/feet) = 1 point. Total APGAR = 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 6 or 7? Let us recalculate: HR (>100)=2, Resp(irregular)=1, Muscle(some flexion)=1, Reflex(grimace)=1, Color(acrocyanosis)=1 => Sum is 6. Wait! If HR=2, Resp=1, Tone=1, Reflex=1, Color=1 = 6! Let option B be 6. Let us verify: 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 6.
questions.explanation_mr: गणना: हृदय गती >१०० = २ गुण; श्वसन (अनियमित) = १ गुण; स्नायू ताण (काही वाकणे) = १ गुण; प्रतिक्षिप्त क्रिया (चेहरा वाकडा करणे) = १ गुण; रंग (अ‍ॅक्रोसायनोसिस) = १ गुण. एकूण बेरीज = २+१+१+१+१ = ६ गुण.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS Nursing Officer

questions.question_en: A doctor prescribes 500 mL of Normal Saline to be infused over 4 hours. The available IV infusion tubing has a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What should be the nursing flow rate in drops per minute (gtts/min)?
questions.question_mr: डॉक्टरांनी ५०० मिली नॉर्मल सलाईन ४ तासांत देण्याचे आदेश दिले आहेत. IV इन्फ्युजन सेटचा ड्रॉप फॅक्टर १५ drops/mL आहे. परिचारिकेने प्रति मिनिट किती थेंब (drops/min) दर सेट करावा?
questions.explanation_en: Formula: (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / (Time in Minutes). Here: (500 mL × 15) / (4 hours × 60 min) = 7500 / 240 = 31.25 drops/min, which rounds to approximately 31 drops/min.
questions.exam_name: NORCET

questions.question_en: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) in India, which vaccine is given strictly INTRADERMALLY (ID) on the left upper arm at birth or as early as possible?
questions.question_mr: भारतातील राष्ट्रीय लसीकरण वेळापत्रकानुसार जन्माच्या वेळी किंवा शक्य तितक्या लवकर डाव्या दंडावर केवळ इंट्राडर्मल (ID) मार्गाने कोणती लस दिली जाते?
questions.explanation_en: BCG vaccine is given intradermally (0.05 mL at birth or 0.1 mL if given after 4 weeks of age up to 1 year) over the insertion of the left deltoid muscle using a tuberculin syringe to produce a characteristic permanent scar.
questions.explanation_mr: बीसीजी लस ही क्षयरोगापासून (TB) संरक्षणासाठी डाव्या दंडावर इंट्राडर्मल मार्गाने दिली जाते. जन्मावेळी डोस ०.०५ मिली असतो.
questions.exam_name: Maharashtra DHS Staff Nurse

questions.question_en: An arterial blood gas (ABG) report of a patient with severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) reveals: pH 7.30, PaCO2 58 mmHg, and HCO3- 26 mEq/L. How should the nurse interpret this ABG finding?
questions.question_mr: तीव्र सीओपीडी (COPD) असलेल्या रुग्णाचा धमनी रक्त वायू (ABG) अहवाल: pH 7.30, PaCO2 58 mmHg, आणि HCO3- 26 mEq/L. परिचारिकेने या ABG चे कसे स्पष्टीकरण करावे?
questions.explanation_en: Normal pH is 7.35-7.45 (7.30 indicates Acidosis). Normal PaCO2 is 35-45 mmHg (58 mmHg indicates carbon dioxide retention / respiratory cause). Normal HCO3- is 22-26 mEq/L (26 is at the upper normal limit, showing the kidneys have not yet significantly elevated bicarbonate to compensate). Hence, this is Uncompensated Respiratory Acidosis.
questions.explanation_mr: pH ७.३० हा आम्लता (Acidosis) दर्शवतो. PaCO2 ५८ mmHg श्वसन प्रणालीमुळे कार्बन डायऑक्साईड साचल्याचे दर्शवतो. बायकार्बोनेट (HCO3) सामान्य मर्यादेत असल्याने अद्याप भरपाई झालेली नाही. म्हणून हे अनकॉम्पेन्सेटेड रेस्पिरेटरी अ‍ॅसिडोसिस आहे.
questions.exam_name: NORCET

questions.question_en: Which anatomical structure is known as the natural primary pacemaker of the human heart, and where is it precisely located?
questions.question_mr: मानवी हृदयाचा नैसर्गिक प्राथमिक पेसमेकर म्हणून कोणती शरीररचना ओळखली जाते आणि ती अचूक कोठे स्थित आहे?
questions.option_a_en: Atrioventricular (AV) Node, in the lower interatrial septum
questions.option_b_en: Sinoatrial (SA) Node, at the junction of the superior vena cava and right atrium
questions.option_b_mr: सायनोअ‍ॅट्रियल (SA) नोड, सुपीरियर व्हेना काव्हा आणि उजव्या अलिंदाच्या जंक्शनवर
questions.option_c_en: Bundle of His, along the interventricular septum
questions.option_d_en: Purkinje Fibers, in the ventricular myocardium
questions.explanation_en: The Sinoatrial (SA) Node initiates electrical impulses at an intrinsic rate of 60-100 times per minute and is located subepicardially in the posterolateral wall of the right atrium near the entry of the superior vena cava.
questions.explanation_mr: सायनोअ‍ॅट्रियल (SA) नोड हे हृदयाचे नैसर्गिक पेसमेकर आहे, जे सुपीरियर व्हेना काव्हा उजव्या अलिंदात (Right Atrium) प्रवेश करते त्या ठिकाणी स्थित असते.
questions.exam_name: ESIC Nursing Officer

questions.question_en: A patient with paranoid schizophrenia states firmly to the nurse: "The nurses in the hallway are whispering secret military codes through the air vents to poison my dinner." What is the most appropriate therapeutic nursing communication response?
questions.question_mr: पॅरानाईड स्किझोफ्रेनिया असलेला रुग्ण परिचारिकेला ठामपणे सांगतो: "हॉलवेमधील परिचारिका माझ्या जेवणात विष कालवण्यासाठी एअर व्हेंटमधून गुप्त लष्करी कोड कुजबुजत आहेत." सर्वात योग्य उपचारात्मक संभाषण प्रतिसाद कोणता?
questions.option_a_en: "No one is whispering codes, that is completely illogical and impossible."
questions.option_a_mr: "कोणीही कोड कुजबुजत नाहीये, हे पूर्णपणे अतार्किक आणि अशक्य आहे."
questions.option_b_en: "Why do you think the nurses would want to poison your food?"
questions.option_b_mr: "परिचारिकांना तुमच्या अन्नात विष का कालवायचे आहे असे तुम्हाला वाटते?"
questions.option_c_en: "I understand that this feels very frightening to you, but I do not hear any whispers. You are safe here."
questions.option_c_mr: "मला समजते की हे तुम्हाला खूप भीतीदायक वाटते, परंतु मला कोणताही आवाज ऐकू येत नाही. तुम्ही येथे सुरक्षित आहात."
questions.option_d_en: "I will go outside right now and strictly tell them to stop whispering."
questions.option_d_mr: "मी आत्ताच बाहेर जाऊन त्यांना कुजबुजणे थांबवायला सांगतो."
questions.explanation_en: In therapeutic communication with delusional patients, the nurse must acknowledge the patient feelings (empathy) while presenting reality gently without arguing or validating the delusion.
questions.explanation_mr: भ्रमिष्ट (डिल्युशनल) रुग्णांशी बोलताना त्यांच्या भीतीची जाणीव ठेवून सहानुभूती दाखवावी आणि भ्रमाला दुजोरा न देता वास्तव शांतपणे स्पष्ट करावे ("मला तो आवाज ऐकू येत नाही, पण तुम्ही सुरक्षित आहात").
questions.exam_name: AIIMS Nursing Officer

questions.question_en: Marathi Grammar: What is the correct idiomatic meaning of the Marathi phrase "हात दाखवणे" (Haat Dakhavane)?
questions.question_mr: मराठी व्याकरण: खालीलपैकी "हात दाखवणे" या वाकप्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ कोणता?
questions.option_a_en: To give a beating / punish (मार देणे किंवा चोप देणे)
questions.option_b_en: To help someone (मदत करणे - हात देणे)
questions.option_c_en: To surrender / admit defeat (शरण येणे - हात टेकणे)
questions.option_d_en: To refuse or hold back (नकार देणे / हात आखडता घेणे)
questions.explanation_en: "हात दाखवणे" (Haat Dakhavane) is a standard Marathi idiom (वाकप्रचार) whose figurative meaning in Marathi Grammar is "मार देणे / चोप देणे / पराक्रम गाजवणे" (to punish or give a sound beating). Example: 'पोलिसांनी चोराला चांगलाच हात दाखवला.' Note: Consulting a palmist for palmistry is a literal interpretation, but in competitive Marathi grammar exams, according to standard curriculum grammar rules (प्रमाण व्याकरण नियमांनुसार), the idiomatic figurative meaning is strictly "मार देणे किंवा चोप देणे". Related idioms: 'हात देणे' = मदत करणे; 'हात टेकणे' = शरण येणे; 'हात आखडता घेणे' = मदत न करणे.
questions.explanation_mr: "हात दाखवणे" या वाकप्रचाराचा प्रमाण मराठी व्याकरणातील लाक्षणिक अर्थ "मार देणे किंवा चोप देणे / पराक्रम दाखवणे" असा होतो (उदा. 'सैनिकांनी सीमेवर शत्रूला चांगलाच हात दाखवला'). टीप: ज्योतिषाला हात दाखवणे हा केवळ शब्दशः अर्थ आहे; स्पर्धा परीक्षेत प्रमाण व्याकरण नियमांनुसार वाकप्रचाराचा लाक्षणिक अर्थ विचारला जातो, जो "मार देणे" हाच असतो. इतर संबंधित वाकप्रचार: 'हात देणे' = मदत करणे; 'हात टेकणे' = पराभव मान्य करणे / शरण येणे; 'हात आखडता घेणे' = मदत न करणे.
questions.exam_name: Maharashtra DMER Staff Nurse

questions.question_en: According to Biomedical Waste Management Rules 2016 in India, human anatomical waste must be segregated in which color container?
questions.explanation_en: Human anatomical waste, organs, tissues, and placenta belong to the Yellow category and are treated via incineration or deep burial.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as IV sets, catheters, and disposable syringes (without needle) must be placed in:
questions.explanation_en: Red bags are designated exclusively for recyclable contaminated plastic wastes that are autoclaved/microwaved and shredded.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Sharps waste including needles, scalpels, surgical blades, and contaminated cut-glass must be disposed of in:
questions.explanation_en: Waste sharps are placed in white translucent, puncture-proof, tamper-proof containers (PPC).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Broken glassware, empty medicine vials, and ampoules contaminated with drugs or blood must be placed in:
questions.explanation_en: Discarded glassware, medicine ampoules, and vials are placed in puncture-proof boxes or containers marked in Blue.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Where should expired or discarded cytotoxic drugs and items contaminated by chemotherapy agents be segregated?
questions.option_a_en: Yellow bag with cytotoxic hazard label
questions.explanation_en: Cytotoxic drugs and contaminated accessories must go into yellow bags marked with the Cytotoxic symbol for high-temp incineration.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: An expired unit of whole blood or packed red blood cells (blood bag) should be disposed of in which container?
questions.explanation_en: Blood bags (both expired and empty used units) are classified under Yellow category (Yellow-c: soiled waste / blood products).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following items must be discarded in the RED bag?
questions.explanation_en: Urine bags, Foley catheters, IV tubing, and plastic gloves are recyclable plastic items and belong in Red bags.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Orthopedic metallic bone plates, pins, and screws removed during surgery are placed in:
questions.explanation_en: Metallic body implants and orthopedic hardware belong to the Blue category container along with glassware.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Cotton pads, gauze pieces, and bandages soaked with pus and blood should be segregated in:
questions.explanation_en: Items soiled with blood, body fluids, or pus (cotton, dressings, linen) belong to the Yellow bag category.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Non-infectious municipal hospital waste like food remnants, vegetable peels, and clean papers should be disposed of in:
questions.explanation_en: General non-biomedical waste should never enter BMW streams; it is segregated into green (wet/biodegradable) or black/blue (dry) bins.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Under the 2016 BMW Rules, the use of which specific type of plastic bags is strictly prohibited in hospitals?
questions.explanation_en: Chlorinated plastic bags are banned because incinerating chlorinated plastic produces hazardous carcinogenic dioxins and furans.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the ultimate treatment and disposal method for waste sharps collected in white puncture-proof containers?
questions.option_a_en: Autoclaving/dry heat followed by shredding or encapsulation in sharps pit
questions.explanation_en: Sharps are autoclaved/dry-heat treated to decontaminate, then shredded/mutilated or encapsulated in concrete sharps pits.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Plaster of Paris (POP) casts contaminated with patient wound drainage should be segregated into:
questions.explanation_en: POP casts and bandages soiled with blood or wound fluids are categorized as Yellow soiled waste.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Used disposable surgical masks and head caps worn during routine clinical care belong to which waste category?
questions.explanation_en: Used PPE like masks, caps, and shoe covers are treated as soiled non-recyclable infectious waste (Yellow bag).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following materials should NEVER be disposed of via incineration?
questions.option_b_en: Pressurized aerosol cans and mercury-containing devices
questions.explanation_en: Pressurized cans (risk of explosion), heavy metals like mercury (toxic vapors), and PVC plastics must never be incinerated.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: According to BMW Rules 2016, untreated biomedical waste cannot be stored in a healthcare facility beyond:
questions.explanation_en: Biomedical waste cannot be stored beyond 48 hours without prior authorization and valid reasons.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the required minimum temperature of the secondary combustion chamber in a biomedical waste incinerator?
questions.explanation_en: The secondary chamber must operate at 1050°C ± 50°C with at least 2 seconds gas residence time to destroy dioxins.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the operating temperature of the primary combustion chamber of a hospital incinerator?
questions.explanation_en: The primary chamber operates at 800°C ± 50°C to combust organic solids into gas and ash.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What tracking technology is mandatory on biomedical waste bags under BMW Rules to ensure trace-to-disposal tracking?
questions.option_b_en: QR code stamped on patient charts
questions.explanation_en: The CPCB mandates a barcoding system on all BMW bags and containers to monitor waste generation and movement.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Under BMW Rules 2016, any major accident occurring during biomedical waste handling must be reported to authorities within:
questions.explanation_en: Accidents involving waste spillage, fires, or injuries must be reported to the prescribed authority within 24 hours in Form I.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Annual report of biomedical waste generated and treated must be submitted by the healthcare facility by which date every year?
questions.explanation_en: Every occupier must submit an annual report in Form IV to the State Pollution Control Board on or before 30th June every year.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Pre-treatment of microbiology, biotechnology, and clinical laboratory cultures before leaving the hospital premises is done by:
questions.explanation_en: Microbiology and pathology lab cultures must be pre-treated on-site by autoclaving or microwaving as per WHO guidelines.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Deep burial of biomedical waste is permissible ONLY in:
questions.option_a_en: Rural or remote areas where common BMW treatment facilities (CBMWTF) are not available
questions.explanation_en: Deep burial is strictly restricted to isolated remote/rural areas with towns having less than 5 lakh population and lacking CBMWTF access.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: The minimum stack height (chimney) required for a biomedical waste incinerator is:
questions.explanation_en: CPCB norms mandate that an incinerator stack must be at least 30 meters above ground level to ensure safe dispersion.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Liquid pathological or chemical waste generated from clinical laboratories must be treated in:
questions.explanation_en: Hospital liquid effluents must be chemically disinfected and treated in an Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) before discharge.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the biohazard symbol requirement on biomedical waste bags?
questions.option_a_en: Mandatory on all yellow, red, blue, and white containers
questions.explanation_en: All biomedical waste bags and containers must prominently carry the international Biohazard symbol.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the maximum fill level recommended for biomedical waste bags before they are sealed and removed?
questions.explanation_en: Bags should be tied and sealed when they reach three-fourths (3/4th) capacity to prevent spillage and puncture.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which document must accompany biomedical waste when transported to a Common Biomedical Waste Treatment Facility (CBMWTF)?
questions.explanation_en: Waste transport must be accompanied by a standardized consignment note (manifest) to track custody and quantity.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Under BMW Rules, periodic medical examination and immunization of all waste handling workers must be done:
questions.option_a_en: At the time of joining and at least once every year
questions.explanation_en: Waste handlers must undergo pre-employment and annual health checkups, including vaccination against Hepatitis B and Tetanus.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Who is legally responsible for the safe handling and segregation of biomedical waste inside a hospital?
questions.option_a_en: The Occupier (hospital management / head of institution)
questions.explanation_en: The 'Occupier' (the person who has ultimate control over the healthcare facility) bears primary statutory responsibility.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended duration for hand hygiene using an alcohol-based hand rub (ABHR)?
questions.explanation_en: WHO guidelines specify that applying alcohol-based rub and rubbing all surfaces until dry should take 20 to 30 seconds.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended duration for routine handwashing with plain soap and water?
questions.explanation_en: Routine hand hygiene with soap and running water requires 40 to 60 seconds to achieve effective microbial reduction.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Under which of the following circumstances is handwashing with soap and water MANDATORY over alcohol-based hand rub?
questions.option_a_en: When hands are visibly dirty or soiled with blood/body fluids
questions.option_b_en: Immediately after touching clean bed linen
questions.explanation_en: Soap and water is mandatory whenever hands are visibly soiled, dirty, or contaminated with proteinaceous fluids.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why is soap and water handwashing required instead of alcohol rub after caring for a patient with Clostridioides difficile diarrhea?
questions.option_a_en: Alcohol rubs are ineffective against bacterial endospores produced by C. difficile
questions.option_b_en: Soap reacts chemically with C. difficile toxins
questions.explanation_en: Alcohol rub does not destroy bacterial spores. Mechanical friction and rinsing with soap and water physically wash away the spores.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the WHO '5 Moments for Hand Hygiene'?
questions.option_c_en: Before taking a tea break in the hospital canteen
questions.option_d_en: Before taking a tea break in the hospital canteen
questions.explanation_en: The 5 Moments are: 1. Before patient contact, 2. Before clean procedure, 3. After body fluid exposure, 4. After patient contact, 5. After touching surroundings.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which moment of hand hygiene protects the healthcare worker and healthcare environment from contamination?
questions.option_b_en: Moment 3 (After body fluid risk) and Moment 4 (After touching patient)
questions.explanation_en: Moments 3, 4, and 5 occur after patient/environment exposure and protect the worker and subsequent patients from pathogen spread.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the ideal alcohol concentration in an effective alcohol-based hand rub solution?
questions.explanation_en: Alcohol concentrations between 60% and 80% have optimal antimicrobial efficacy; pure 100% alcohol evaporates too fast and coagulates protein coats without penetrating.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What type of skin flora is responsible for most healthcare-associated cross-infections and can be easily removed by routine handwashing?
questions.explanation_en: Transient microflora colonize superficial skin layers following patient contact and are the primary source of cross-infection, easily removed by hygiene.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why should healthcare workers avoid wearing artificial acrylic nails and nail extenders in clinical settings?
questions.option_a_en: They harbor high concentrations of gram-negative bacilli and yeast under the subungual area
questions.explanation_en: Studies show artificial nails harbor gram-negative bacteria and Candida even after thorough handwashing, contributing to surgical infections.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: In surgical hand scrub, how long should the initial antiseptic scrub before the first case of the day typically take?
questions.explanation_en: Standard surgical scrub with antimicrobial soap (chlorhexidine/povidone-iodine) takes 3 to 5 minutes. Longer scrubbing causes skin irritation without extra benefit.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: When using an alcohol-based hand rub, what is the critical endpoint before touching the patient?
questions.option_a_en: Wiping excess rub onto an apron
questions.option_b_en: Rinsing hands immediately under a water tap
questions.option_c_en: Blowing breath onto hands to accelerate drying
questions.option_d_en: Blowing breath onto hands to accelerate drying
questions.explanation_en: Hands must be rubbed continuously until completely dry; touching surfaces while wet impairs efficacy and increases glove puncture risk.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Wearing gloves replaces the need for hand hygiene:
questions.option_a_en: Only in the Intensive Care Unit
questions.option_b_en: Never; hand hygiene must be performed before putting on and after removing gloves
questions.explanation_en: Gloves do not guarantee complete protection due to micro-perforations and contamination during doffing. Hand hygiene is mandatory after glove removal.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the correct sequence for putting on (DONNING) Personal Protective Equipment?
questions.explanation_en: CDC standard sequence for Donning PPE is: 1. Gown, 2. Mask/Respirator, 3. Eye protection (Goggles/Face shield), 4. Gloves.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the correct sequence for removing (DOFFING) Personal Protective Equipment?
questions.explanation_en: Doffing removes the most contaminated items first: 1. Gloves, 2. Eye protection, 3. Gown, 4. Mask/Respirator (removed last outside room).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What does the 'N95' designation in an N95 respirator signify?
questions.option_a_en: Protects for 95 minutes of continuous use
questions.explanation_en: 'N' means Not resistant to oil, and '95' means it filters at least 95% of airborne test particles with mass median aerodynamic diameter of 0.3 microns.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What check should a healthcare worker perform every single time they put on an N95 respirator?
questions.option_a_en: User seal check (positive and negative pressure check)
questions.explanation_en: A user seal check (fit check) must be performed every time an N95 is donned to ensure an airtight perimeter seal.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: During which type of procedures is an N95 respirator mandatory instead of a standard surgical triple-layer mask?
questions.option_a_en: Aerosol-generating procedures (e.g., endotracheal intubation, bronchoscopy, CPR)
questions.explanation_en: Aerosol Generating Procedures (AGPs) on respiratory patients generate high viral particle loads requiring airborne N95 protection.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why are surgical triple-layer masks NOT recommended for protection against true airborne pathogens like Mycobacterium tuberculosis?
questions.option_a_en: They do not form a tight facial seal and allow unfiltered air to enter around loose edges
questions.explanation_en: Surgical masks lack a perimeter seal and only protect against large droplets, leaving open gaps where airborne droplet nuclei penetrate.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What type of gloves must be worn by sanitation workers while collecting and transporting heavy biomedical waste bags?
questions.option_a_en: Heavy-duty nitrile or rubber utility gloves
questions.explanation_en: Waste handlers require thick, puncture-resistant, heavy-duty utility gloves to safeguard against sharp punctures and chemical leaks.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: When removing an N95 respirator or surgical mask, which part of the mask should NEVER be touched with bare hands?
questions.option_b_en: The outer front surface of the mask
questions.option_c_en: The rear side of the head
questions.option_d_en: The rear side of the head
questions.explanation_en: The front of the mask is heavily contaminated with trapped aerosols; touch only the head straps/ties behind the ears when doffing.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the primary role of a fluid-resistant face shield in clinical procedures?
questions.option_a_en: To protect eyes, nose, and mouth mucous membranes from splashes and sprays of blood and body fluids
questions.option_b_en: To keep hair out of the eyes
questions.option_c_en: To replace the need for an N95 during intubation
questions.option_d_en: To replace the need for an N95 during intubation
questions.explanation_en: Face shields protect facial mucous membranes against blood, amniotic fluid, and irrigating fluid splatter.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Double-gloving during major orthopedic and trauma surgeries is primarily recommended to:
questions.option_a_en: Significantly reduce the risk of inner glove perforation and blood contact during sharp bone manipulation
questions.explanation_en: Double gloving reduces inner glove perforation by up to 70-80%, drastically cutting blood exposure risk during vigorous bone surgery.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the standard holding temperature, pressure, and time for routine steam sterilization (Autoclaving)?
questions.explanation_en: Standard saturated steam autoclave cycle operates at 121°C (250°F) under 15 psi chamber pressure for 15-20 minutes.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: In high-speed pre-vacuum autoclaves (flash cycle), what are the standard operating parameters?
questions.explanation_en: Pre-vacuum flash autoclaves operate at 134°C under 30 psi for 3 to 5 minutes for rapid turnover.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which organism's endospores are used as the standard biological indicator to validate steam autoclaves?
questions.explanation_en: Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores are extremely heat-resistant and serve as the global biological indicator for moist heat autoclaving.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What are the standard temperature and holding time requirements for dry heat sterilization in a Hot Air Oven?
questions.explanation_en: Hot air ovens require 160°C for 2 hours, 170°C for 1 hour, or 180°C for 30 minutes for dry-heat destruction of spores.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which biological indicator is used to monitor dry heat sterilization (hot air oven) and Ethylene Oxide (ETO)?
questions.explanation_en: Bacillus atrophaeus spores are specifically resistant to dry heat and Ethylene Oxide gas, making them the standard indicator.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the Bowie-Dick test used for in sterile processing departments (CSSD)?
questions.option_a_en: To detect air leaks and evaluate vacuum efficacy in dynamic pre-vacuum steam sterilizers
questions.explanation_en: Bowie-Dick test assesses whether air is effectively evacuated from pre-vacuum sterilizers; trapped air pockets prevent steam penetration.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Ethylene Oxide (ETO) gas sterilization is primarily chosen for items that are:
questions.option_a_en: Heat-sensitive, moisture-sensitive electrical and plastic medical equipment
questions.explanation_en: ETO is an alkylating gas used at low temperatures (37-55°C) for delicate devices like cameras, pacemakers, and plastics that melt under steam.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why is a prolonged degassing/aeration phase mandatory following Ethylene Oxide (ETO) sterilization?
questions.option_a_en: Because ETO gas residues and ethylene chlorohydrin are highly toxic, irritant, and mutagenic to human tissues
questions.option_c_en: To allow humidity to build up
questions.option_d_en: To allow humidity to build up
questions.explanation_en: Aeration (8-12 hours at elevated temperature) is mandatory to eliminate toxic, tissue-irritating ETO gas residues before patient use.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the sterilizing agent used in low-temperature STERRAD plasma sterilization systems?
questions.option_a_en: Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) vapor and gas plasma
questions.explanation_en: STERRAD uses vaporized hydrogen peroxide followed by radiofrequency excitation into free radical plasma, leaving harmless water vapor and oxygen.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which chemical indicator class responds to all critical parameters (time, temperature, saturated steam) of an autoclave cycle?
questions.explanation_en: Class 5 integrating indicators react to all critical sterilization variables and correlate closely with biological indicators.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: According to Earle Spaulding's criteria, a medical device that enters sterile tissues or the vascular system is classified as:
questions.explanation_en: Critical items (surgical instruments, cardiac catheters, vascular implants) enter sterile tissue/blood and require complete sterilization.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Flexible gastrointestinal endoscopes contact mucous membranes but do not penetrate sterile tissue. They are classified as:
questions.explanation_en: Semi-critical items touch intact mucous membranes or non-intact skin and require at least High-Level Disinfection (HLD).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Blood pressure cuffs, stethoscopes, and bedpans contact only intact skin. They are classified as:
questions.explanation_en: Non-critical items contact only intact skin and require low-to-intermediate level disinfection or cleaning with detergent and water.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the minimum contact time required for high-level disinfection of endoscopes using 2% alkaline Glutaraldehyde (Cidex)?
questions.explanation_en: High-level disinfection with 2% glutaraldehyde requires immersion for 20 minutes at room temperature (sterilization requires 10 hours).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is a major advantage of Ortho-phthalaldehyde (OPA 0.55%) over 2% Glutaraldehyde?
questions.option_b_en: OPA can be discarded directly in regular sinks without neutralization
questions.explanation_en: OPA is ready-to-use, has lower vapor pressure (less respiratory irritation), and achieves HLD in 12 minutes (FDA validated).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why must flexible endoscopes undergo rigorous enzymatic detergent cleaning and brushing BEFORE chemical disinfection?
questions.option_a_en: Because bioburden and organic debris inactivate disinfectants and prevent chemical contact with microbes
questions.explanation_en: Cleaning is the single most critical step; unremoved organic matter shields microorganisms from disinfectant contact.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: How should endoscopes be stored after reprocessing to prevent bacterial proliferation?
questions.option_a_en: Hung vertically in a dedicated clean, well-ventilated cabinet with dry internal channels
questions.explanation_en: Vertical hanging allows moisture drainage and air drying; residual moisture fosters growth of waterborne pathogens like Pseudomonas.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the immediate first-aid measure following an accidental needle-stick injury in a clinical ward?
questions.option_a_en: Wash the site gently with soap and running water
questions.option_b_en: Soak the finger in 100% bleach or povidone iodine
questions.option_c_en: Suck the puncture site with the mouth
questions.option_d_en: Suck the puncture site with the mouth
questions.explanation_en: Immediately wash gently with soap and running water. Do not squeeze, scrub vigorously, or apply harsh chemical irritants.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following actions is strictly PROHIBITED after a needle-stick injury?
questions.option_a_en: Squeezing or sucking the wound, and rubbing with caustic antiseptics
questions.option_b_en: Reporting to the infection control nurse
questions.option_c_en: Checking patient's serology status with consent
questions.option_d_en: Checking patient's serology status with consent
questions.explanation_en: Squeezing traumatizes tissue and creates negative pressure that sucks pathogens deeper into the microvasculature.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) for HIV should ideally be started within how many hours of exposure?
questions.explanation_en: PEP is most effective when initiated within 2 hours; the window closes after 72 hours, beyond which it offers minimal protective benefit.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended total duration of an HIV Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) drug regimen?
questions.explanation_en: Standard antiretroviral PEP regimen must be taken faithfully for a complete course of 28 days.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the estimated risk of transmission following a percutaneous needle-stick exposure to Hepatitis B in an unvaccinated individual (HBeAg positive source)?
questions.explanation_en: Transmission risk rule of thumb: HBV (30%), HCV (3%), HIV (0.3%). Hepatitis B is by far the most transmissible blood-borne pathogen.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the estimated risk of HIV transmission following a percutaneous hollow-bore needle-stick injury from a known HIV-positive source?
questions.explanation_en: The average risk of HIV transmission after a hollow-bore needle stick exposure to infected blood is estimated at 0.3%.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What serum anti-HBs antibody level indicates adequate long-term protective immunity against Hepatitis B in a vaccinated healthcare worker?
questions.explanation_en: An anti-HBs antibody titer of 10 mIU/mL or greater measured 1-2 months after completing the 3-dose Hep B series confirms immunity.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: An unvaccinated healthcare worker suffers a needle-stick injury from an HBsAg-positive source. What is the recommended management?
questions.option_a_en: Administer both Hepatitis B Immune Globulin (HBIG) and initiate the Hepatitis B vaccine series immediately
questions.explanation_en: Simultaneous administration of HBIG (passive immunity) and Hep B vaccine (active immunity) at different injection sites within 24 hours is required.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Is there an approved Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) vaccine or immunoglobulin available for Hepatitis C exposure?
questions.option_b_en: No approved PEP exists; baseline and follow-up HCV RNA/antibody testing is monitored
questions.explanation_en: No vaccine or post-exposure prophylaxis is approved for Hepatitis C; management relies on close laboratory surveillance and early treatment with direct-acting antivirals if infection occurs.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What practice is the single leading cause of preventable needle-stick injuries among hospital nurses?
questions.explanation_en: Two-handed recapping accounts for a large fraction of sharps injuries; used needles must NEVER be recapped using two hands.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: If a used needle MUST be recapped before disposal, which technique should be strictly followed?
questions.option_b_en: Pressing the needle tip against a hard wall
questions.option_c_en: Bending the needle with fingers first
questions.option_d_en: Bending the needle with fingers first
questions.explanation_en: The one-handed 'scoop' technique (using the needle to scoop up the cap without touching it with the opposite hand) is the only approved recapping method.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What concentration of freshly prepared Sodium Hypochlorite solution is recommended for managing a LARGE blood spill (> 10 mL)?
questions.explanation_en: Large blood spills (>10 mL) require 1% freshly prepared sodium hypochlorite (10,000 ppm available chlorine) to overcome organic neutralization.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended disinfectant and concentration for cleaning SMALL blood spots or droplets (< 10 mL)?
questions.explanation_en: Small spills or blood drips (<10 mL) are managed by wiping with 0.1% sodium hypochlorite (1,000 ppm available chlorine).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the correct procedure for managing a 20 mL blood spill on an ICU floor?
questions.option_a_en: Pour 1% hypochlorite on paper towels covering spill from periphery to center, wait 20-30 min, discard in yellow bag
questions.option_b_en: Sweep with a dry broom and vacuum
questions.option_c_en: Spray air freshener and let dry
questions.option_d_en: Spray air freshener and let dry
questions.explanation_en: Cover spill with absorbent towels, pour 1% hypochlorite from outside inwards, allow 20-30 minutes contact time, clean up into Yellow BMW bag.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why must sodium hypochlorite solution be prepared freshly every 24 hours?
questions.option_a_en: Chlorine evaporates and decomposes rapidly upon exposure to light and air, losing biocidal potency
questions.option_c_en: It turns into solid salt within hours
questions.option_d_en: It turns into solid salt within hours
questions.explanation_en: Aqueous hypochlorite degrades rapidly; daily fresh preparation ensures adequate active free chlorine concentration.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following actions is strictly FORBIDDEN when managing a spilled clinical mercury thermometer?
questions.option_a_en: Vacuuming with an ordinary electric vacuum cleaner or sweeping with a broom
questions.option_b_en: Sprinkling sulfur powder over tiny droplets
questions.option_c_en: Placing collected mercury in a sealed airtight bottle
questions.option_d_en: Placing collected mercury in a sealed airtight bottle
questions.explanation_en: Vacuuming or sweeping vaporizes and atomizes mercury droplets into toxic breathable aerosols, creating severe inhalation toxicity.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: In the 'Two-Bucket' or 'Three-Bucket' mopping system used in hospitals, what is the role of the second/middle bucket?
questions.option_a_en: To rinse the dirty mop and remove soil before dipping into the clean disinfectant bucket
questions.explanation_en: Rinsing dirty mops in a separate rinsing bucket prevents rapid contamination and neutralization of the fresh disinfectant in the primary bucket.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the minimum recommended air changes per hour (ACH) for a standard operating theatre under NABH guidelines?
questions.option_b_en: Minimum 20 ACH (with at least 4 fresh air changes)
questions.explanation_en: NABH guidelines require OT air systems to provide at least 20 total air changes per hour with positive pressure relative to corridors.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What type of air pressure relationship is maintained inside an Operating Theatre relative to adjacent semi-restricted areas?
questions.explanation_en: Operating rooms maintain positive pressure so clean air flows outwards, preventing airborne dust and microbes from entering when doors open.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: A Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) is clinically defined as an infection occurring in a patient during hospital care that was:
questions.option_a_en: Not present nor incubating at the time of hospital admission (typically arising >= 48 hours after admission)
questions.option_c_en: Developing within 2 hours of entering the casualty
questions.option_d_en: Developing within 2 hours of entering the casualty
questions.explanation_en: HAIs are infections occurring >= 48 hours after admission that were neither active nor incubating on admission.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following is the single most important intervention in the CAUTI (Catheter-Associated UTI) prevention bundle?
questions.option_a_en: Limiting catheter use to strictly necessary clinical indications and removing it promptly
questions.option_b_en: Irrigating the bladder twice daily with chlorhexidine
questions.option_c_en: Changing the Foley catheter every 48 hours
questions.option_d_en: Changing the Foley catheter every 48 hours
questions.explanation_en: Avoiding unnecessary catheterization and removing existing catheters as early as possible is the cornerstone of CAUTI prevention.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: To prevent CAUTI, where should the urinary drainage collection bag be positioned at all times?
questions.option_a_en: Below the level of the patient's bladder and never touching the floor
questions.option_b_en: Hanging on the side railing above bed level
questions.option_c_en: Placed directly resting on the floor
questions.option_d_en: Placed directly resting on the floor
questions.explanation_en: Drainage bags must remain below bladder level to prevent retrograde urine reflux while avoiding floor contact to prevent contamination.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which skin antiseptic solution is recommended by international guidelines for Central Venous Line (CLABSI) insertion prep?
questions.explanation_en: Chlorhexidine with 70% alcohol provides superior rapid bactericidal action and sustained residual antimicrobial activity on the skin.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which anatomical insertion site carries the highest risk of Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection (CLABSI) and should be avoided in adults?
questions.explanation_en: The femoral site has high bacterial colonization, proximity to groin skin folds, and higher thrombotic and infection risks.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following is a key element of the Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia (VAP) prevention bundle?
questions.option_a_en: Maintaining elevation of the head of bed between 30 to 45 degrees
questions.option_b_en: Changing the ventilator circuit tubing every 12 hours
questions.explanation_en: Elevating the head of bed to 30-45 degrees prevents microaspiration of gastric secretions and colonized oropharyngeal secretions into lungs.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is 'Sedation Vacation' in the context of the ICU VAP bundle?
questions.option_a_en: Daily spontaneous awakening trial to assess readiness to extubate
questions.option_c_en: Changing sedatives from propofol to midazolam
questions.option_d_en: Changing sedatives from propofol to midazolam
questions.explanation_en: Daily interruption of sedation allows assessment of neurologic readiness for extubation, shortening ventilator days and VAP incidence.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: According to WHO surgical infection guidelines, what is the optimal timing for prophylactic intravenous antibiotic administration prior to surgical incision?
questions.option_a_en: Within 60 minutes before skin incision (120 min for vancomycin/fluoroquinolones)
questions.option_b_en: At the end of surgery during skin closure
questions.option_c_en: Only when the patient spikes a fever postoperatively
questions.option_d_en: Only when the patient spikes a fever postoperatively
questions.explanation_en: Administering antibiotics within 60 minutes before skin incision ensures bactericidal tissue drug concentrations at the time of tissue opening.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended preoperative hair removal method to reduce Surgical Site Infections (SSI)?
questions.option_a_en: Hair should not be removed unless necessary; if required, use electric clippers immediately before surgery
questions.option_b_en: Chemical depilatory creams on all patients
questions.option_c_en: Waxing the surgical field 3 days earlier
questions.option_d_en: Waxing the surgical field 3 days earlier
questions.explanation_en: Razors create microscopic cutaneous nicks that foster bacterial multiplication. If hair obstructs the field, electric clippers are used just prior to surgery.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which type of isolation precautions is required for an open cavitary pulmonary Tuberculosis (TB) patient?
questions.explanation_en: TB bacilli are transmitted via droplet nuclei (<5 microns) that remain suspended in air currents, requiring Airborne Isolation.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What engineering feature is essential for an Airborne Infection Isolation Room (AIIR)?
questions.option_a_en: Negative air pressure with >= 12 air changes per hour (ACH) and HEPA exhaust
questions.option_c_en: Laminar airflow directed towards the door
questions.option_d_en: Laminar airflow directed towards the door
questions.explanation_en: Negative pressure ensures air flows inward when the room door is opened, preventing airborne nuclei from leaking into hospital corridors.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Patients with active Influenza, Meningococcal meningitis, or Rubella require which type of precautions?
questions.explanation_en: Large respiratory droplets (>5 microns) travel short distances (within 1-2 meters), requiring Droplet Precautions (surgical mask upon entry).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What PPE must a healthcare provider wear before entering a Contact Precautions isolation room (e.g., Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus - MRSA)?
questions.option_a_en: N95 respirator and sterile boots only
questions.explanation_en: Contact Precautions require wearing a gown and gloves for all interactions involving the patient or their contaminated environment.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which infectious condition requires BOTH Airborne and Contact Precautions?
questions.explanation_en: Varicella-zoster virus is transmitted both by airborne droplet nuclei from vesicles/respiratory tract and direct contact with open skin lesions.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why are pregnant healthcare workers typically reassigned from caring for active Cytomegalovirus (CMV) or Rubella cases?
questions.option_a_en: These pathogens are proven teratogens capable of causing congenital malformations or fetal demise
questions.explanation_en: CMV, Rubella, and Parvovirus B19 cause severe congenital defects (teratogenesis) and fetal harm during pregnancy.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the minimum spatial separation recommended between patient beds in a general ward to reduce droplet transmission?
questions.option_a_en: At least 1 to 2 meters (3 to 6 feet)
questions.option_c_en: No distance needed if curtains are drawn
questions.option_d_en: No distance needed if curtains are drawn
questions.explanation_en: WHO and CDC recommend at least 1-2 meters (3-6 feet) physical distance between beds to minimize transmission from respiratory droplets.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is 'Protective Environment' (Reverse Isolation) designed for?
questions.option_a_en: To protect severely immunocompromised patients (e.g., allogeneic bone marrow recipients) from fungal and bacterial spores
questions.explanation_en: Protective environments use positive pressure, sealed rooms, and HEPA filtration to safeguard severely neutropenic patients from fungal spores like Aspergillus.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which vaccination is mandatory for all healthcare personnel having potential blood and body fluid exposure?
questions.option_a_en: Hepatitis B vaccine (3-dose series at 0, 1, and 6 months)
questions.explanation_en: Hepatitis B vaccination is legally and professionally mandated for all clinical personnel with risk of occupational blood exposure.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: When evaluating a healthcare worker's response to the 3-dose Hepatitis B vaccine, blood anti-HBs titers should be tested:
questions.option_a_en: 1 to 2 months after completing the third vaccine dose
questions.option_c_en: Only if the person gets jaundice
questions.option_d_en: Only if the person gets jaundice
questions.explanation_en: Testing 1 to 2 months after the final dose documents seroconversion and establishes non-responder status if titers remain <10 mIU/mL.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What should be done if a healthcare worker is found to be a 'non-responder' (< 10 mIU/mL) after the first 3-dose Hep B series?
questions.option_a_en: Administer a second complete 3-dose series (or challenge dose) and retest anti-HBs titers
questions.option_b_en: Prohibit them from ever working in a clinic
questions.explanation_en: Non-responders receive a repeat 3-dose series (0, 1, 6 months) and are retested. If still non-responsive, they are counseled as true non-responders.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the maximum permissible shelf life of properly wrapped, double-layer woven muslin fabric sterilized surgical packs?
questions.option_a_en: Event-related (or up to 21-30 days if stored clean, dry, and undisturbed in standard conditions)
questions.explanation_en: Muslin-wrapped packs typically have a 21-30 day shelf-life if stored clean and dry; however modern practice is 'event-related' (sterile until package integrity is compromised).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: If a sterile surgical instrument tray drops onto the operating room floor with its packaging intact, what must be done?
questions.option_a_en: Consider the pack contaminated, do not open, and send for full reprocessing/resterilization
questions.option_b_en: Open quickly and use within 5 minutes
questions.option_c_en: Inspect visually; if clean, use it
questions.option_d_en: Inspect visually; if clean, use it
questions.explanation_en: Physical impact or drop can force air and microbes through packaging seams; dropped packs must be treated as unsterile and reprocessed.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the primary function of an ultrasonic cleaner in CSSD instrument decontamination?
questions.option_a_en: Cavitation (microscopic bubbles imploding) to dislodge blood and debris from joints, crevices, and box locks
questions.option_b_en: Drying sharp blades with hot air
questions.explanation_en: Ultrasonic sound waves create cavitation bubbles that implode and pull microscopic biological debris out of serrations and hinges.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why must ophthalmic surgical instruments undergo rigorous final rinsing with sterile, deionized, pyrogen-free water?
questions.option_a_en: To prevent Toxic Anterior Segment Syndrome (TASS) caused by residual enzymatic detergents or chemical endotoxins
questions.option_c_en: To prevent rust on plastic handles
questions.option_d_en: To prevent rust on plastic handles
questions.explanation_en: TASS is a sterile postoperative endophthalmitis caused by heat-stable chemical residues or endotoxins left on intraocular instruments.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended method to decontaminate instruments exposed to patients with suspected Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (Prions)?
questions.option_a_en: Autoclaving at 134°C for 18 minutes in a pre-vacuum sterilizer or immersion in 1N NaOH for 1 hour followed by autoclaving
questions.explanation_en: Prions are abnormally folded proteins resistant to standard heat and chemicals; stringent protocols (134°C for >=18 min or 1N NaOH) are mandatory.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: A nurse notes that an IV cannula site has developed redness, warmth, pain, and a palpable cord along the vein. What is the immediate nursing action?
questions.option_a_en: Immediately stop the infusion, remove the cannula, and elevate the limb
questions.option_b_en: Slow down the infusion rate to half
questions.option_c_en: Inject 5 mL of normal saline forcefully
questions.option_d_en: Inject 5 mL of normal saline forcefully
questions.explanation_en: Signs indicate thrombophlebitis; the cannula must be discontinued immediately to prevent catheter-related septic thrombophlebitis and bacteremia.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: In a hemodialysis unit, how is the dialyzer machine hydraulic circuit disinfected between patients to prevent pyrogenic reactions?
questions.option_a_en: Heat disinfection or validated chemical disinfection (peracetic acid / citric acid) as per protocol
questions.explanation_en: Dialysis circuits must undergo validated thermal or chemical (peracetic acid/citric acid) disinfection to eliminate bacteria and endotoxins.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the color code of the biomedical waste container used for discarding expired cytotoxic ampoules and bottles in India?
questions.option_a_en: Yellow container with Cytotoxic symbol and 'CYTO' marking
questions.explanation_en: Cytotoxic drug waste must be marked with the cytotoxic emblem and packed in yellow bags/boxes for dedicated high-temperature destruction.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which organism is the most notorious cause of hospital-acquired waterborne outbreaks associated with hospital taps, showers, and cooling towers?
questions.explanation_en: Legionella and Pseudomonas form biofilms in hospital plumbing and cooling systems, posing major aerosol and waterborne infection hazards.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why must chlorhexidine skin prep be allowed to dry completely on skin before initiating electrocautery in surgery?
questions.option_a_en: Because the alcohol solvent is volatile and flammable, presenting a flash-fire risk when cautery arcs
questions.option_b_en: Because drying increases stickiness of surgical drapes
questions.option_c_en: Because wet chlorhexidine leaves purple stains
questions.option_d_en: Because wet chlorhexidine leaves purple stains
questions.explanation_en: Alcohol fumes trapped beneath surgical drapes can ignite instantly when electrocautery sparks, causing catastrophic surgical fires.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the standard holding period for monitoring biological indicators (Geobacillus stearothermophilus) in modern rapid-readout incubators?
questions.option_a_en: 1 to 3 hours (with enzyme-based fluorescence readout) up to 24-48 hours for conventional spore vials
questions.explanation_en: Rapid readout biological indicator systems detect alpha-glucosidase enzyme activity within 1-3 hours, replacing old 7-day incubation.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the primary reason why hospital staff should never walk between patient rooms wearing the same pair of examination gloves?
questions.option_a_en: Gloves transfer pathogenic micro-organisms from one patient and surface to another, driving cross-infection outbreaks
questions.option_b_en: Gloves tear easily if worn too long
questions.option_c_en: Gloves cause contact dermatitis if worn between beds
questions.option_d_en: Gloves cause contact dermatitis if worn between beds
questions.explanation_en: Gloves pick up heavy bioburden; wearing them across multiple patients is a major cause of multi-drug resistant organism (MDRO) dissemination.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which chemical indicator class is designed to react to a specific cycle parameter and is placed on the outside of packs to show they went through a sterilizer cycle?
