questions.explanation_en: Class 1 process indicators (such as external autoclave indicator tape) simply show whether a package has been exposed to the sterilization process.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which chemical indicator class is classified as an 'Emulating Indicator' (reacting to all critical variables for a specified cycle)?
questions.explanation_en: Class 6 emulating indicators are cycle-specific indicators designed to react to all critical variables for specific cycles (e.g., 134°C for 3.5 min).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why is chlorhexidine gluconate contraindicated for surgical skin prep of the eye, middle ear, and meninges?
questions.option_a_en: It causes severe corneal injury (keratopathy) and irreversible sensorineural ototoxicity
questions.explanation_en: Chlorhexidine is toxic to delicate neuro-sensory structures, causing permanent corneal damage and deafness if it enters the middle ear cavity.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which disinfectant is recommended for environmental surface cleaning in rooms occupied by patients with active Clostridioides difficile?
questions.option_a_en: Sodium hypochlorite solution (>= 5,000 ppm available chlorine)
questions.explanation_en: C. difficile spores are resistant to quats and alcohol; sporicidal hypochlorite solution (at least 5,000 ppm available chlorine) is required.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Under safe injection guidelines, what is the maximum recommended usage period for a multi-dose vial once punctured, unless otherwise specified by the manufacturer?
questions.option_c_en: Until the bottle is completely empty
questions.option_d_en: Until the bottle is completely empty
questions.explanation_en: CDC guidelines stipulate multi-dose vials should be dated upon opening and discarded within 28 days unless manufacturer specifies differently.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the first-line preferred 3-drug regimen for HIV Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) under national and WHO guidelines?
questions.explanation_en: The preferred first-line PEP regimen is once-daily Tenofovir + Lamivudine (or Emtricitabine) combined with Dolutegravir for 28 days.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: In the '1/1/1 Rule' for microbiological air monitoring using the Settle Plate method in operating rooms, what does 1/1/1 stand for?
questions.option_c_en: 1 meter above patient bed for 10 minutes
questions.option_d_en: 1 meter above patient bed for 10 minutes
questions.explanation_en: The 1/1/1 Settle Plate method: Nutrient/blood agar plates placed 1 meter above the floor, 1 meter away from walls/obstacles, and exposed for 1 hour.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the permissible upper limit of Colony Forming Units (CFU) per cubic meter of air in an ultra-clean laminar airflow Operating Theatre?
questions.explanation_en: Ultra-clean OTs (e.g., for joint replacement or cardiac surgery) should maintain air bioburden below 10 CFU/m³ (and < 1 CFU per settle plate).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: How should heavily soiled, blood-stained hospital bed linens be handled and bagged in the patient care area?
questions.option_a_en: Rolled gently inward to contain soil and placed directly into a leak-proof yellow bag at the site of use
questions.option_b_en: Washed immediately in the ward sink
questions.option_c_en: Left open on the floor for laundry pickup
questions.option_d_en: Left open on the floor for laundry pickup
questions.explanation_en: Linens must be gently contained without shaking (to prevent aerosolizing pathogens) and placed in leak-proof bags at the point of origin.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended minimum hot-water washing cycle temperature and duration for hospital laundry decontamination?
questions.option_a_en: 71°C (160°F) for at least 25 minutes (or 65°C for 10 minutes)
questions.explanation_en: CDC and NHS laundry standards mandate thermal disinfection at 71°C for at least 25 minutes (or 65°C for 10 min) with appropriate detergents.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which component of a blood spill kit is used to safely lift broken glass or sharps from a blood spill without hand contact?
questions.option_a_en: Mechanical forceps, tongs, or disposable scoop and scraper
questions.explanation_en: Sharps in a spill must never be picked up with hands, even gloved; forceps, tongs, or plastic dustpans/scrapers must be used.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is a microbial 'Biofilm' and why is it dangerous in indwelling medical devices?
questions.option_a_en: A structured community of microorganisms encased in an extracellular polymeric matrix highly resistant to antibiotics and disinfectants
questions.option_b_en: A sterile layer of host antibodies
questions.explanation_en: Biofilms protect bacteria from host defenses and antimicrobials (up to 1,000-fold more resistant), leading to persistent device infections.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What type of respiratory protection is required when entering a room of a patient undergoing active airborne isolation with suspected Avian Influenza or SARS-CoV?
questions.option_a_en: N95 particulate respirator or higher (e.g., FFP3 / PAPR)
questions.explanation_en: High-consequence airborne or novel viral respiratory infections mandate well-fitted N95 respirators or Powered Air-Purifying Respirators (PAPRs).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Under the 2018 Amendment to the BMW Rules, within what timeframe were healthcare establishments required to phase out chlorinated plastic bags?
questions.explanation_en: The 2018 BMW Amendment mandated complete phase-out of chlorinated plastic bags and gloves within two years of the 2016 notification.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which method of terminal room decontamination utilizes an automated vaporized or misting system without leaving wet chemical residues?
questions.option_a_en: Hydrogen Peroxide Vapor (HPV) / UV-C automated decontamination systems
questions.explanation_en: Automated HPV and pulsed-xenon UV-C room systems achieve 4-to-6 log microbial reductions on surfaces, especially useful post-outbreak.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the proper procedure for collecting a urine specimen from an indwelling Foley catheter for microbiological culture?
questions.option_a_en: Aspirate urine with a sterile syringe through the needleless sampling port after disinfecting with alcohol
questions.option_b_en: Collect urine from the bottom drainage bag petcock
questions.option_c_en: Squeeze the tubing until urine leaks
questions.option_d_en: Squeeze the tubing until urine leaks
questions.explanation_en: Specimens must be drawn aseptically from the needleless aspiration port after disinfection. Disconnecting tubing breaks closed drainage and causes CAUTI.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the maximum duration an un-cuffed peripheral intravenous catheter should remain in place before routine evaluation/resite in an adult?
questions.option_a_en: Clinically indicated or 72-96 hours if signs of phlebitis or complication appear
questions.explanation_en: CDC guidelines recommend evaluating peripheral IV sites daily and replacing when clinically indicated (phlebitis, occlusion) or every 72-96 hours.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which of the following is considered an 'Aerosol Generating Procedure' (AGP) carrying high risk of airborne pathogen transmission?
questions.option_a_en: Endotracheal intubation, open suctioning, bronchoscopy, and manual bag-mask ventilation
questions.option_c_en: Drawing blood from a peripheral vein
questions.option_d_en: Drawing blood from a peripheral vein
questions.explanation_en: Airway instrumentation like intubation, CPR, bronchoscopy, and non-invasive positive pressure ventilation are high-risk AGPs.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the primary indicator organism used to validate low-temperature Hydrogen Peroxide Gas Plasma sterilizers (STERRAD)?
questions.explanation_en: Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores serve as the biological challenge indicator for hydrogen peroxide gas plasma sterilization.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: When transporting an infectious tuberculosis patient outside their airborne isolation room for an essential CT scan, what PPE should the PATIENT wear?
questions.explanation_en: The patient should wear a surgical mask (source control) to trap expelled droplets; valved N95 masks allow exhaled infectious air to escape directly.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Under NABH standards, what is the required hand hygiene compliance audit formula?
questions.option_a_en: (Total soap bottles used / Total nurses) x 100
questions.explanation_en: Compliance (%) = (Observed Hand Hygiene Actions / Total Valid Hand Hygiene Opportunities) x 100, monitored via direct observation.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What type of disinfectant is Sodium Dichloroisocyanurate (NaDCC) and what is its key advantage over liquid Sodium Hypochlorite?
questions.option_a_en: Chlorine donor available in stable dry effervescent tablet form with longer shelf life
questions.explanation_en: NaDCC tablets dissolve in water to release active chlorine, offering superior chemical stability and longer shelf life than liquid bleach.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the minimum concentration of alcohol required in an effective antiseptic surgical rub?
questions.explanation_en: Surgical hand rubs require 70-85% alcohol (isopropanol or ethanol) with emollients and persistent antimicrobial agents (e.g., chlorhexidine).
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which diagnostic test is standard for determining latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) in healthcare personnel upon baseline employment?
questions.option_a_en: Tuberculin Skin Test (TST / Mantoux) or Interferon-Gamma Release Assay (IGRA - QuantiFERON)
questions.explanation_en: TST (Mantoux) or IGRA blood assays detect cell-mediated immune responses to M. tuberculosis antigens, screening for latent infection.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Why should multidose insulin vials NEVER be shared between different patients, even if needles and syringes are changed each time?
questions.option_a_en: Backflow of blood and tissue fluid into the vial during aspiration can cross-contaminate the entire vial with HBV/HCV
questions.option_c_en: Insulin crystallizes when exposed to different needles
questions.option_d_en: Insulin crystallizes when exposed to different needles
questions.explanation_en: Puncturing a vial creates negative/positive pressure swings that carry microscopic blood particles into the vial, transmitting blood-borne viruses.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended method for cleaning and disinfecting computer keyboards and diagnostic monitors in intensive care units?
questions.option_a_en: Wiping with 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes or manufacturer-approved disinfectant wipes with waterproof keyboard covers
questions.option_b_en: Dry dusting with a feather duster
questions.option_c_en: Spraying 5% phenol directly on the monitor screen
questions.option_d_en: Spraying 5% phenol directly on the monitor screen
questions.explanation_en: Wiping gently with 70% alcohol wipes or hospital disinfectant wipes prevents electrical damage while disinfecting high-touch surfaces.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: Which antibiotic stewardship strategy involves reviewing prescribed broad-spectrum antibiotics 48-72 hours after initiation to de-escalate to targeted therapy?
questions.explanation_en: An 'Antibiotic Time-Out' at 48-72 hours evaluates culture results to stop, de-escalate, or tailor therapy, reducing resistance and C. difficile.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: In CSSD packaging, what is the role of medical-grade sterilization pouches (Tyvek / Paper-Plastic peel pouches)?
questions.option_a_en: To allow sterilant penetration during processing while providing a microbial barrier and preserving sterility until point of use
questions.option_b_en: To make instruments lighter in weight
questions.explanation_en: Sterilization pouches are semi-permeable membranes allowing steam/gas penetration during the cycle, while keeping microbes out after cooling/drying.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the recommended minimum contact time for 70% Isopropyl Alcohol when disinfecting a medication vial rubber septum or IV needleless injection port (scrubbing the hub)?
questions.option_a_en: Scrub vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds and allow to air dry completely
questions.option_c_en: No scrubbing needed if needle is sterile
questions.option_d_en: No scrubbing needed if needle is sterile
questions.explanation_en: 'Scrub the Hub' guidelines require vigorous mechanical friction with 70% alcohol for at least 10-15 seconds followed by complete drying.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

questions.question_en: What is the international biohazard warning label color and symbol standard on all biomedical waste packaging?
questions.option_a_en: Fluorescent orange or orange-red background with the universal three-crescent Biohazard symbol and legible lettering
questions.option_b_en: Plain white box with black checkmark
questions.explanation_en: Biohazard labels feature the iconic universal 3-ring biohazard symbol on an orange, orange-red, or bright yellow background with bold warning text.
questions.explanation_mr: पर्याय A हे या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर आहे.
questions.exam_name: AIIMS NORCET / State Nursing Officer Exam

case_studies.title_en: Acute Anterior Wall Myocardial Infarction in Emergency Dept
case_studies.title_mr: आपत्कालीन विभागात तीव्र अँटीरियर वॉल मायोकार्डियल इन्फार्कशन
case_studies.chief_complaint_en: Crushing retrosternal chest pain radiating to left jaw and left arm for past 90 minutes, accompanied by diaphoresis and nausea.
case_studies.chief_complaint_mr: मागील ९० मिनिटांपासून डाव्या जबड्याकडे आणि डाव्या हाताकडे जाणारी छातीत तीव्र वेदना, सोबत खूप घाम येणे आणि मळमळ.
case_studies.history_and_vitals_en: History of Hypertension for 10 years, smoker. Vitals: BP 88/54 mmHg, Heart Rate 118 bpm, SpO2 91% on room air, Respiratory Rate 24/min.
case_studies.history_and_vitals_mr: १० वर्षांपासून उच्च रक्तदाबाचा इतिहास, धूम्रपान करणारा. महत्त्वाचे संकेत: रक्तदाब ८८/५४ mmHg, नाडी ११८ ठोके/मिनिट, ऑक्सिजन ९१%, श्वसन २४/मिनिट.
case_studies.clinical_investigations_en: 12-lead ECG reveals 3mm ST-segment elevation in leads V1 to V4. Cardiac Troponin I is elevated at 4.2 ng/mL.
case_studies.clinical_investigations_mr: १२-लीड ईसीजी मध्ये V1 ते V4 लीड्समध्ये 3mm ST-सेगमेंट एलिव्हेशन. कार्डियाक ट्रॉपोनिन I ४.२ ng/mL वर वाढलेले आढळले.

case_studies.title_en: Severe Pre-eclampsia in a Primigravida at 34 Weeks Gestation
case_studies.title_mr: ३४ आठवड्यांच्या गरोदरपणात प्रिमोग्रॅव्हिडा मध्ये तीव्र प्री-एक्लॅम्पसिया
case_studies.chief_complaint_en: Severe frontal headache, blurring of vision, and epigastric discomfort since morning.
case_studies.chief_complaint_mr: सकाळपासून डोक्यात तीव्र वेदना, दृष्टी धूसर होणे आणि पोटाच्या वरच्या भागात अस्वस्थता.
case_studies.history_and_vitals_en: Primigravida at 34 weeks gestation. Vitals: BP 168/110 mmHg, HR 88 bpm, RR 18/min. Urine dipstick shows 3+ proteinuria.
case_studies.history_and_vitals_mr: ३४ आठवड्यांची प्रिमोग्रॅव्हिडा. बीपी १६८/११० mmHg, नाडी ८८, श्वसन १८. लघवीच्या चाचणीत ३+ प्रोटीन्युरिया आढळले.
case_studies.clinical_investigations_en: Deep tendon reflexes: 4+ hyperreflexia with sustained ankle clonus. Platelet count 95,000/mcL.
